problem: The explicitly required hasStructuralMember relationship has no sh:minCount, so a ship with no linked structural member passes without exposing any required readiness inputs or result.
required_change: Add sh:minCount 1 to the nltl:hasStructuralMember property shape.
regression_guard: Preserve mandatory availability of at least one structural-member relationship while retaining per-member validation.

problem: The additional sh:class nltl:benchmarkEntity constraint is not required by the declared owner classes or model path and can reject a valid nltl:structuralMember solely because it lacks benchmarkEntity classification.
required_change: Remove sh:class nltl:benchmarkEntity from the structural-member node shape; retain sh:class nltl:structuralMember.
regression_guard: Do not impose benchmarkEntity classification on linked structural members unless explicitly required by the authoritative dependency contract.
